'''Sereine dar Shamelle Motara''' was Counsel-Sister to Comaelle, High Queen of [[Jaramide]], circa {{ab|325}}, the [[Third Age]]. She is the author of the ''[[Karaethon Cycle#Commentaries|Commentaries on the Karaethon Cycle]]''. {{ref|{{twotc}}, Sereine dar Shamelle Motara}} {{ref/book|4|1}}
